video_title: CADE CUNNINGHAM WAS FLAWLESS 😤 But are Pistons still a TOP TEAM in the East? | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Kenny Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Smith and Tim MacMahon debate the impact of the Pistons-Wizards game
quotes.excerpt: it's a bigger loss for Washington and a big win because when you're not at full strength

text_blocks.speaker: Kenny Smith
text_blocks.text: It's a bigger loss for Washington and a big win because when you're not at full strength, you're trying to steal games until the Pistons get at full strength, when Jalen Duren comes back and everyone is fully acclimated. But when you're full strength and you're 4-7, and you're trying to be a team that's supposed to be a sleeper team that people weren't expecting to get into the playoffs, that's a bigger loss for the Wizards than to have one guy to have that type of game when you have your full strength.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: I think it's a bigger loss for the Wizards than actually the win for the Pistons.

quotes.social_post: Kenny Smith argues that the recent Pistons win over the Wizards is a much bigger loss for Washington than it is a statement win for Detroit given the current roster health of both teams.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon evaluates the Pistons' roster flaws and long-term outlook
quotes.excerpt: they don't have a legit number two option. Saddiq Bey is an elite role player

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: The Pistons were the number one seed in the East last year. They were a 60-win team last year. Then their biggest flaw was exposed in the playoffs and that was they don't have a legit number two option. Saddiq Bey is an elite role player. Jalen Duren is a, let's be honest, he's a glorified dirty work big man. A very good player but not a co-star. There's a reason why they were trying to throw a bunch of money at Austin Rivers. There's a reason why they explored other things.

text_blocks.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
text_blocks.text: Wait, don't do my brother like that. Don't do my brother like that.

quotes.social_post: Tim MacMahon says the Pistons biggest flaw remains the lack of a legit number two option behind their star and calls Jalen Duren a glorified dirty work big man rather than a co-star.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Smith on the defensive challenges of double-teaming elite offensive players
quotes.excerpt: if you double team that best offensive player, the second guy you might have to double team

text_blocks.speaker: Kenny Smith
text_blocks.text: If you double team that best offensive player, the second guy you might have to double team as well. If you're talking about obviously the 76ers, obviously with Paul George and Jayson Tatum. So, defensively you have to really stretch yourself and plug a lot of holes.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: I understand what you're saying, Tim, is role. But the role of Thompson is defense. The role of Duren is rebounding. The role of Cade is scoring. They need another role scorer, a role player who their job is to put buckets on the board.

quotes.social_post: Kenny Smith breaks down the defensive challenges of modern NBA rosters and explains why the Pistons specifically need another role player whose primary job is to put buckets on the board.
